CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: parentUrn data is present for a known customer profile
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open Tapir using a customer account known to include parentUrn data. Access the customer profile and confirm a parentUrn value is available before performing functional checks.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
A non-empty parentUrn value is available for the selected customer.
Testing can proceed without data substitution workarounds.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: parentUrn is displayed on the customer profile
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to the customer profile page in Tapir and locate the parentUrn field in the profile details area.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The parentUrn field is visible on the customer profile.
The displayed value is not truncated or hidden by layout issues.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: parentUrn remains visible after profile refresh/reopen
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Close and reopen the same customer profile, then refresh the page and confirm the parentUrn field still appears consistently.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The parentUrn field remains visible after reopen and refresh.
No intermittent disappearance is observed.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Authorized users can view the parentUrn field
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Using an account for a Personal Shopper or reservation-creating role, open a customer profile and confirm parentUrn visibility.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The parentUrn field is visible for the authorized role.
No permission warning blocks read access for intended users.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: No unintended masking of parentUrn for business users
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat profile access with another business user role responsible for reservation creation and verify parentUrn is shown in the same area.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The field is consistently visible across intended reservation-related roles.
Field placement and readability are consistent.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: User can copy parentUrn from the customer profile
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select and copy the displayed parentUrn value using keyboard or UI copy interaction if available.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Copy action succeeds without errors.
Clipboard contains a value matching the displayed parentUrn.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Copied parentUrn pastes into Concierge input without format problems
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Paste the copied parentUrn into the target Concierge field used during reservation creation and review the pasted value.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Pasted value matches the copied parentUrn exactly.
No extra spaces, line breaks, or altered characters are introduced.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat the copy from Tapir and paste into Concierge for a second customer profile to confirm consistency.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Second execution behaves the same as first run.
No inconsistent formatting or paste failures are observed across repetitions.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Upstream data dependency may block functional validation if parentUrn is not populated
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Before starting full UAT, sample at least two customer profiles expected to have parentUrn and confirm data is present.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: At least one testable profile has a populated parentUrn and allows full execution of visibility/copy/paste checks.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: High — blocks all downstream AC checks if dependency is unmet
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Pre-requisite in story AC explicitly states dependency on Customer Data Team availability

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Approved reservation-related roles can view and copy parentUrn consistently.
